recognize_zh: 這是正常周邊血抹片：紅血球大小一致、有中央淡染區；黃色箭頭為 3–5 葉分葉核的嗜中性球，綠色箭頭細胞質塞滿深紫色粗顆粒、遮蔽細胞核的是嗜鹼性球，紫色箭頭為細胞質灰藍、核形不規則的單核球，血小板數量正常。
features: Normocytic, normochromic red cells with central pallor and minimal anisopoikilocytosis
Segmented neutrophils (yellow arrows) with 3–5 nuclear lobes and pale pink finely granular cytoplasm
Basophil (green arrow) with coarse dark purple granules overlying and obscuring the nucleus
Monocyte (purple arrow) with irregular folded nucleus and grey-blue cytoplasm with an irregular border
Adequate scattered single platelets without clumping; no immature or atypical cells
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with preserved central pallor and no significant poikilocytosis. The white cells shown include mature segmented neutrophils without toxic change or hypersegmentation, a basophil with coarse dark purple granules obscuring the nucleus, and a monocyte with a folded nucleus and grey-blue cytoplasm. Platelets appear adequate in number and morphology. No blasts, nucleated red cells or inclusions are identified. Findings are consistent with a normal peripheral blood smear.

ddx.vs: Eosinophils have a bilobed nucleus that remains visible beneath uniform refractile orange-red granules, whereas basophil granules are dark purple-black and obscure the nucleus.
Toxic granules are fine, dark and evenly distributed over pale cytoplasm with a clearly visible segmented nucleus, not coarse granules masking the nucleus.
Reactive lymphocytes have deeply basophilic cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and a round nucleus, whereas monocytes have folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm.
